newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill starts seven life insurers.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill starts seven life insurers.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said analyst Edward Spehar initiated coverage of seven life insurers.
-- Torchmark Corp was named Merrill's Focus One stock; coverage initiated with an intermediate and long-term buy rating.
-- UNUM Corp and Jefferson-Pilot Corp started with intermediate-term accumulate rating, long-term buy rating, Merrill said.
-- American General Corp and Equitable of Iowa Cos started with intermediate- and long-term accumulate ratings.
-- Lincoln National Corp and Western National Corp started with intermediate-term neutral, long-term accumulate ratings.
-- Spehar not immediately available for comment.
